mode: local HTML prototype; page.setContent; no network, app server, API or database
viewportCapture: fullPage screenshot at deviceScaleFactor 1; viewport is also recorded per image

requestedStates.selectedWaiting: Supported for Designer; selector-driven Waiting / blocked metric filters the matching sample queue.
requestedStates.empty: Supported for Designer; unique no-match search produces the prototype empty state.
requestedStates.error: Supported as an explicit local simulation via View Settings > Preview UX error states > Simulate load failure; does not issue a request.
requestedStates.loading: No independently triggerable pending/initial loading state exists in this prototype. Not fabricated or captured.
requestedStates.accessDenied: Prototype checklist says actual route guard is required; role preview is not authorization. Not represented.

dataLimit: All task names, IDs, statuses and counts are supplied sample data. Use screenshots only as visual references. The prototype lower-case waiting sample is not a canonical backend enum; actual acceptance uses canonical status values.
